visual.all: Preserve the approved soft griffin identity; silhouettes and gestures must distinguish states without their labels.
visual.Listening: Attentive head tilt and wing near cheek.
visual.Working: Alternating wing tips visibly press a gold control pad, with actual contact rather than a UI-only pulse.
visual.Ready: Perked head and raised wing or celebration gesture.
visual.fur: Wing surfaces and their fibers move coherently; no stationary duplicate wing or new bald patch.

behavior: Accessible state buttons and validated window.grifonCompanion.setState API select all five states.
State head, wing and prop trajectories differ; working cursor response is attenuated.
Blink reaches full closure and reopens.
Pause freezes pose, state age, taps, props, transitions and tour progress; resume continues.
Reduced motion uses distinct static poses without idle oscillation or an automatic tour.
Rapid switching cleans up transient props and Ready blink; manual selection cancels tour and remains selected.
Preview all runs approximately three seconds per state and ends Idle.
Invalid API state is rejected without changing state.
Context loss, load failure and render exceptions preserve fallback and recovery.
320, 375, 390 and 1280 pixel viewports have no horizontal overflow and interactive targets at least 44 pixels.
Normal operation has no console errors or page errors.
limits: Manual reaction previews do not use a microphone or perform actual jobs.
Desktop AMD rendering and mobile emulation are not evidence of real-phone performance.
Fixed-camera baked lighting is not GLB/PBR or splat validation.
